metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Beijing all decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P OFFL NO₂ tropospheric column product for Beijing in the two stated periods. 2. Masking: Tropospheric NO₂ from S5P is delivered already screened for clouds; we do not apply additional cloud masks. 3. Logic: Compute spatial mean NO₂ tropospheric column density for the two windows. If either collection is empty → C1 If the resulting mean is None/NaN or an invalid negative value → C3 Compare Jan mean (Jan 1-20) vs Feb mean (Feb 10-25). If Feb mean is strictly lower → A (Yes) Otherwise → B (No) ```python import ee, datetime ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions beijing = ee.Geometry.Point([116.4074, 39.9042]).buffer(25000) # 25 km around city centre janStart, janEnd = '2020-01-01', '2020-01-20' febStart, febEnd = '2020-02-10', '2020-02-25' # Helper to get collection & mean def no2_mean(start, end): col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') .filterDate(start, end) .filterBounds(beijing)) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: return None, 0 img = col.mean() count = img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=beijing, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() val = img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=beijing, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() return val, count # 2. Data Acquisition & Check jan_val, jan_cnt = no2_mean(janStart, janEnd) feb_val, feb_cnt = no2_mean(febStart, febEnd) if jan_val is None or feb_val is None: print("C1: Empty Collection for at least one period.") print("C1") else: print(f"Jan 1-20 NO₂: {jan_val:.3e} mol/m², Pixels: {jan_cnt}") print(f"Feb 10-25 NO₂: {feb_val:.3e} mol/m², Pixels: {feb_cnt}") if jan_cnt == 0 or feb_cnt == 0: print("C2: No valid pixels in one period.") print("C2") elif jan_val is None or feb_val is None or jan_val < 0 or feb_val < 0: print("C3: Invalid NO₂ values.") print("C3") else: if feb_val < jan_val: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee, datetime
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
beijing = ee.Geometry.Point([116.4074, 39.9042]).buffer(25000)  # 25 km around city centre
janStart, janEnd = '2020-01-01', '2020-01-20'
febStart, febEnd = '2020-02-10', '2020-02-25'

# Helper to get collection & mean
def no2_mean(start, end):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2')
             .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
             .filterDate(start, end)
             .filterBounds(beijing))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0:
        return None, 0
    img = col.mean()
    count = img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=beijing,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    val   = img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=beijing,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    return val, count

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
jan_val, jan_cnt = no2_mean(janStart, janEnd)
feb_val, feb_cnt = no2_mean(febStart, febEnd)

if jan_val is None or feb_val is None:
    print("C1: Empty Collection for at least one period.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    print(f"Jan 1-20 NO₂: {jan_val:.3e} mol/m², Pixels: {jan_cnt}")
    print(f"Feb 10-25 NO₂: {feb_val:.3e} mol/m², Pixels: {feb_cnt}")
    if jan_cnt == 0 or feb_cnt == 0:
        print("C2: No valid pixels in one period.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif jan_val is None or feb_val is None or jan_val < 0 or feb_val < 0:
        print("C3: Invalid NO₂ values.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        if feb_val < jan_val:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
